summary.text: John Tatar is the U.S. Taxpayers Party candidate for Michigan House of Representatives District 32 in the November 3, 2026 general election; the incumbent is Jimmie Wilson Jr. (D).

paragraphs.text: Tatar advanced from the U.S. Taxpayers Party convention on July 18, 2026.
According to Ballotpedia, he ran for Michigan's 11th Congressional District as a Libertarian in 2012, when he received 2.7 percent of the vote, and again in 2014, when he received 3.1 percent.
He was also a Libertarian candidate for the Michigan State Board of Education in 2018, with 1.1 percent of the vote.
In the 2022 special general election for Wayne County Sheriff he ran as a U.S. Taxpayers Party candidate and received 7.4 percent of the vote.
